name: PDFsam Basic
author: Sober Lemur S.r.l.
summary: A free, open source, multi-platform software designed to split, merge, extract pages, mix and rotate PDF files.

versions.release_notes:
- Upgraded dependencies with fixes for known vulnerabilities (Bouncy Castle CVE-2026-103605 through CVE-2026-103617)
- JDK 25.0.5.1 with the fix for CVE-2026-114938 (Java4Shell)
- Sejda 6.0.0.M9
- Fixed PDF names with non UTF-8 characters being changed on save, which could leave fonts or images missing in the output and rename radio button states
- Split by size: fixed output files missing fonts or images that are shared with pages already processed
- Merge: fixed form fields with garbled text, or text of the wrong size or position, when using Flatten
- Merge: fixed Flatten failing on text fields whose value ends with a line break
- Merge: Flatten no longer fails on form fields without a valid rectangle or using a font with no name
- A corrupt compressed inline image no longer stops processing the rest of the page

- Fixed reordering files with drag and drop in the selection table, broken by the JavaFX 25.0.5 update
- Dragging files to reorder them now shows how many files are being moved
- Updated translations

- JDK 25.0.5.0.3 with the fix for CVE-2026-114820
- JavaFX 25.0.5
- Sejda 6.0.0.M8
- SAMBox 4.0.0.M9
- Updated dependencies
- Closed #663: lists of PDF files are now read using the system charset before falling back to ISO-8859-1, so file names with non-Latin characters load correctly
- Fixed split outputs that could lose changes, like unused fonts removed by compression, when pages share objects in the same object stream
- Fixed document metadata being lost when loading encrypted PDFs with compressed metadata
- Fixed corrupted content when decoding ASCII85 and ASCIIHex encoded streams
- Fixed content that was ignored after stray ), ] or > characters in a page content stream
- A CropBox with zero or negative width or height now falls back to the MediaBox, as other PDF readers do
- Removed the spurious Missing 'endobj' token and Xref stream ended prematurely warnings on valid documents

- Sejda 6.0.0.M7
- Updated translations and added Armenian
- Updated dependencies
- Added support for reading Brotli compressed streams
- Fixed sambox#253: error processing documents with malformed XMP metadata
- Fixed sejda#515: Split by bookmarks: control characters in bookmark titles no longer end up in generated file names
- Fixed sejda#265: Extract: [BASENAME] can now be used alone as output prefix
- Fixed dialogs not following the application window when moved to a second monitor

- JDK 25.0.4
- JavaFX 25.0.4
- Fixed #856 to improve readability
- Refactored logging system
- Updated translations
- Fixed an issue with the compression policy UNCOMPRESSED
- Fixed #855 where the application was trying to load an empty workspace file path at startup

- Allow opening a workspace by drag-and-dropping onto the app icon
- Fixed #845: clear enqueued load-workspace events for the tool selected via Open With dialog, so it opens and loads input files (other tools still load workspace data as usual)
- Fixed #844: clearer description for the smart output checkbox
- Don't maximize the app window on first startup (or after settings are cleared)
- Force JavaFX to load the correct DLLs even when another JDK with JavaFX DLLs is on the PATH
- Upgraded Sejda; removed prefix-based methods for adding menu items
- Upgraded translations

- Stricter security when parsing the Sejda configuration XML file.
- Dependencies bumps
- Overcomes the xref stream parsing 2 GB limitation
- Stricter validation throughout xref-stream parsing to prevent OOM and related issues.
- Added validation on predictor parameters to avoid overflow.
- Bug fix (#248): page deletion no longer fails when the /Kids attribute is missing.

- Compression: output compression is now a three-value option (Compress / Neutral / Uncompress) instead of a simple on/off toggle.
- Drag & drop folder to output field: dropping a folder onto the PDF output field automatically suggests an output file path inside that folder.
- Better handling of problematic PDFs: improved robustness when reading files with malformed annotations, invalid color spaces, broken font dictionaries, malformed metadata and invalid CropBox
- PDF 2.0 support: UTF-8 encoded strings introduced in PDF 2.0 are now correctly read and written.
- Merge fixes: fixed incorrect font size rescaling in Table of Contents merges, improved handling of empty ToC entries and fixed a hang when processing PDFs with certain bookmark
  structures.
- Accessibility improvements: added accessible text, help text and proper label-to-field associations throughout the UI.

- Updated translations and added Lao
